brief: 🔥 FIRECRAWL is the breakout: API for AI agents to scrape/crawl web at scale — infrastructure play for the agent gold rush
Graphify-Labs/Graphify + local-first code graphs = knowledge graph tooling is heating up for AI coding
Skills frameworks (mattpocock, obra) consolidating — pick one or build vertical on top
OCR + spatial intelligence (WiFi presence) = niche plays with breakout potential in enterprise
HERMES-AGENT shows adaptive personalization is the next frontier in agent UX
